features: default native; optional graph, neural, neural-onnx and frontend disabled
notes: Built from the checksum-verified published 1.7.2 crate and locked dependencies with Confidence's selected native feature profile.
The image rebuilds the published source on the pinned Bookworm builder; its executable digest identifies that build separately from upstream release assets.
Default native features include the ordinary call graph used by the bounded selector; the optional graph feature is a separate RDF store.
The image retains upstream licenses, dependency license notices, source pin and executable build manifest.
